def feats(r,c,r0,c0,H,W,I,O):
    out={}
    out['pos']= (r-r0,c-c0)
    # orth/n diag neighbors that are 2
    o=sum(I[r+dr][c+dc]==2 for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W)
    d=sum(I[r+dr][c+dc]==2 for dr,dc in dirs if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W)
    # corner: two opposite diagonal pairs
    corners=(I[r+(-1)][c+(-1)]==2 and I[r+(1)][c+(1)]==2) or (I[r+(-1)][c+(1)]==2 and I[r+(1)][c+(-1)]==2)
    out['orth']=o; out['diag']=d; out['corn']=int(corners)
    return out
